name: trackiq-amazon-stockout-impact
title: TrackIQ: Amazon Stockout Impact and Recovery
summary: Measures what a completed Amazon stockout actually cost — lost units and revenue against the pre-stockout run rate, how far sessions and conversion fell, whether they have come back, and how long recovery is taking — then produces a staged plan for restarting ads and rebuilding rank.

requires.third_party_note: Requires an Oxylabs scraper connection; the public page is the only source for this data.

delivery.note: in-chat always works and is the fallback. Outward sends confirm first.
